get.summary: Mac bazli form egrisi ve sezon trendi

get.description:
Seasons, position groups and metrics the form may offer.

Coverage travels with each metric: xG exists for five leagues out of twelve,
and a form that offers it without saying so would quietly narrow a search to
a fraction of the database.

ComparisonOut.title: ComparisonOut
ComparisonOut.description:
Several players on the axes they all have.

`axes` is the order to draw them in; every player carries a value for each
one. `dropped` names the metrics only some of them had — a gap in one
outline reads as a low score, so those are left out and said out loud.

ComparisonPlayer.title: ComparisonPlayer
ComparisonPlayer.description: One column of the comparison: the player and his value on each axis.

TransferSide.title: TransferSide
TransferSide.description:
One end of a move — a club we hold, or just the name the source gave.

Roughly half of a Süper Lig club's window crosses our coverage, so `id` is
null more often than not. `name` is always there; without it the row would
read "left for nowhere".

ValueMomentumOut.description: What the market did with him over the last year, where it said anything.
